title: GULVIAL bath sheet
description: GULVIAL bath sheet, turquoise, 39x59" Soft and fluffy GULVIAL towel in turquoise is medium-thick (500 g/m²) and made of 100% cotton which makes it durable, highly absorbent and ideal for everyday use. A terry towel in medium thickness that is soft and absorbent (weight 500 g/m²).
features: This product is suitable for use in smaller hotels, inns and B&Bs as the design and material are optimized for frequent use and washing.
The towel will reach full absorbency after one washing.
Grams per square meter (g/m2) indicates the surface density of the fabric. The higher the surface density the more absorbent the towel. A towel with a lower surface density dries faster.
